summary: Big FFA ON/OFF switch, per-mode server load table and ping comparison. Backend: 8 pytest tests (server_health shape, admin-only guards, switch off->403 queue / queue purge / disabled:true / modes_status / back on, WS gate, live per-mode load). Found and FIXED 1 bug: WS gate for mode=bigffa while OFF sent mode_unavailable before websocket.accept() -> RuntimeError -> handshake returned HTTP 500 (client never got mode_unavailable or 4403). After adding accept(), client receives {type: mode_unavailable} and close code 4403. All 8 tests pass. Frontend: Moderation panel (switch, confirm dialog on OFF only, meta text updates, 6 mode rows + totals, ping cards 'Not enough data'), lobby 12P FFA button disabled + 'Temporarily unavailable' when OFF / enabled when ON, and queued player kicked out within ~1s with bigffa-unavailable-toast - all verified. Switch left ON.

critical.issue: FIXED by testing agent: websocket.send_text called before websocket.accept() -> 500 on handshake; added `await websocket.accept()` before sending mode_unavailable + close(4403).

minor.issue: One flaky run returned 200 to an unauthenticated requests.get; 15 curl retries + rerun all returned 401. Could not reproduce (1/17).

issues: 'Temporarily unavailable' label is very small (~10px) and squeezed right after '12P FFA' text on the dimmed orange button; hard to read
Toast at top-center overlaps the player card in the header at 1920 width

Game.jsx closes the socket itself on match_end, so _bigffa_send_home_after_match (10s later) will rarely find a connected player - harmless, but the real 'sent to lobby' path is the match-end overlay / 20s fallback; consider navigating with ?mode_unavailable=1 there when switch is off

context_for_next_testing_agent: WS endpoint is /api/ws/game?token=...&mode=bigffa (token from login JSON / access_token cookie). /play is wrapped by MatchEntryGuard so direct nav to /play?mode=bigffa bounces to /lobby; in-game mode_unavailable handler (Game.jsx) was NOT exercised end-to-end (would need a 2+ min Big FFA match). App shows a loading screen; wait up to 40s for selectors.
rca of the issue: Starlette requires accept() before send(); the bigffa OFF gate called send_text on a CONNECTING socket, raising RuntimeError swallowed by the except, so close(4403) was skipped and the server returned HTTP 500. Repro: switch OFF, connect wss://.../api/ws/game?token=T&mode=bigffa -> InvalidStatus 500. Mitigation: await websocket.accept() first (applied, retested OK).
